top_story: Israel enters a more volatile phase as Likud weighs rejecting unfavorable election results, a step that could turn political polarization into an institutional crisis and further weaken restraints on violence beyond the Green Line. The older case of a Palestinian child permanently injured by a misfired Hamas rocket underscores that civilians remain trapped between abusive actors on all sides and then face chronic neglect in care and recovery. The clearest regional takeaway is that impunity—whether in national politics, militant violence, or settler attacks—is deepening civilian insecurity and narrowing the space for any credible rule of law.
